resources.string: A backup exported from this app. Contains all dream, emotion, and person data.
A backup exported from the legacy app, exists for compatibility reasons. Only partial aspects of the data can be transferred due to differences in the data model.
Configure your data import by selecting what type of backup you want to import. Note that your choice depends on the file that you have.
